ad_intro:
The Man Company (themancompany.com, Instagram: @themancocom) is a prominent Indian men's grooming brand with ~52 active creatives running across Meta in India, spending an estimated Rs.1-2 Cr/mo. Mid-scale D2C brand in the Men's Grooming segment (est. from ad-spend ratios). Three obvious leaks in the funnel:

(1) Creative gap - heavy studio/offer creative with thin real-customer UGC, before/after or demo content. (2) Copy/CRO gap - headlines lead with price/offer rather than outcome, and ad traffic often lands on collections/offer pages rather than the exact SKU. (3) Tracking/retargeting gap - retargeting uses generic creative rather than staged, funnel-matched content; CAPI/return-event wiring is inconsistent. These are fixable in 7-14 days. We estimate 30-45% of ad spend is leaking; HOT - solid spend with obvious quick wins in creative/CRO.

findings: Observed signal: Fragrance SKUs lack video demos. Creative leak (High): Ads over-index on hero/product-pack studio shots and brand ambassador frames, with heavy machismo tropes. Real-customer before/after (beard growth, oil control, fragrance longevity), texture/demo, and grooming-ritual UGC is thin.
Copy leak - generic (High): Headlines lean 'X% off' / 'Beard like a boss' rather than specific outcomes ('72hr fragrance', 'beard dandruff gone in 14 days', 'oil control till end of workday').
Landing page leak (Medium): PDPs lead with brand imagery and offer; texture demo video, ingredient callouts, before/after photos and usage-routine sit below the fold.
Tracking & retargeting leak (Medium): Retargeting is generic-brand; concern/SKU-specific retargeting (beard -> oil+wash combo) underused; replenishment reminders at consumption cycle missing.
competitors: Strong category D2C peer running heavy UGC and SKU-direct routing.
Creative/CTR gap is the main opening.
Faster-growing challenger with rapid creative velocity.
Smaller budget winning on sharper creative.
wins: 25 Reels/month: 30-day beard-growth/health journeys, fragrance longevity tests (workday/gym/night out), texture/sink-in demos, grooming-routine integration, SO-reaction clips. Replace 40% of studio. Expected: CTR +35-50%, CPA -20-30%.
WIN 2 - CRO: Outcome-first PDPs + Grooming-Routine Bundles

15s texture/use demo above fold; outcome strip ('24hr oil control', '72hr fragrance'); routine combos (oil+wash, face wash+moisturizer+sunscreen) at 15% off; sticky ATC with rating+reviews. Expected: CVR +25-35%, AOV +20%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: CAPI + Concern-Specific Retargeting + Replenishment
Concern/SKU-view retargeting with matched creative; replenishment reminders at 30/60/90 days; cross-sell routine to single-SKU buyers. Expected: retargeting ROAS +50-70%, repeat +20%.
